descriptions.en: In search for odd radiation readings.

titles.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的成立

descriptions.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
descriptions.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

descriptions.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
descriptions.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

descriptions.zh: 由其中一位创造者隐藏在远古克隆仓内的基因编码密码向我们揭示了两条道路：重获繁育能力但放弃部分力量，或永远告别自然繁育以到达新的生物学巅峰。
descriptions.en: The hidden bio-code cipher, left by one of the Creators within the Ancient Clone Vats, revealed to us two paths: to reclaim our fertility and forgo part of our strength, or to forever forsake natural reproduction to reach further genetic heights.

descriptions.zh: 在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系发现的一颗完全被缇扬奇尸体覆盖了的行星。想研究这一怪异的埋葬地，我们必须先解决它的守墓人。
descriptions.en: A planet entirely covered in the bodies of dead Tiyanki has been found in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system. In order to study this unusual burial ground, we must first deal with its gravekeepers.

descriptions.zh: 防止人工智能例程凌驾于现有保护措施之上。
descriptions.en: Prevent AI routines from overriding existing safeguards.

descriptions.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
descriptions.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!

descriptions.zh: 我们的一艘舰船迷失于虚境之中。
descriptions.en: One of our vessels has been lost to the Shroud.

descriptions.zh: 由于我们取回了坠毁的运奴飞船上的数据，现在我们已经找到了前家园星球的星系坐标。我们的人民迫不及待地渴望踏上返乡的旅程。
descriptions.en: With the data retrieved from the crashed slaver ship, we have pinpointed the galactic coordinates of our former home worlds. Our people are clamoring for a return.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经找到了弥那玛特种实业集团的星系坐标。
descriptions.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H虚空之低语§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Unfathomable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一个名为§H世界之喰煞§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HEater of Worlds§!. Insatiable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of strife and lament.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H生命之织缕§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HComposer of Strands§!. Sheltering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一个名为§H渴求之器具§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

器具渴求着渴求本身。沉溺享乐、腐化和奴役便是器具的别名。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Pampering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened more easily if we align our actions with the will of our patron.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

descriptions.zh: 微小昆虫的集群突然集体爆发，席卷了整个[myrmeku_planet.GetName]大地。
descriptions.en: Swarms of tiny insects have sprung into action, sweeping across the [myrmeku_planet.GetName] landscape.

descriptions.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的§Y种荚§!带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
descriptions.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our §YSeed Pods§! to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

descriptions.zh: 战争时期，我们的§Y种荚§!可以绽放成为陆军，随时保卫我们的殖民地或者入侵遥远的目标。
descriptions.en: In times of war, our §YSeed Pods§! can blossom into armies, ready to defend our colonies or to invade distant targets.

descriptions.zh: 我门已经定位了适合建造第二座电弧熔炉的理想恒星系。
descriptions.en: We have located an ideal system in which to build a second Arc Furnace.
